external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A person who browses and orders socks through the mobile app and receives faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app, which keeps customer data and hands orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is unspecified: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that processes orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that faxes dispatch confirmations to customers.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer a confirmation
processes.notes: Nobody checks that the fax arrived at the right place.

processes.name: marketing spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unspecified: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether the user database ... [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file containing delivery addresses only.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Encryption at rest is unspecified: "Nobody here can tell me ... whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted."

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet used by Marketing to keep the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: talks over HTTP
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: hand order over
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write delivery address
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.
data_flows.data_description: confirmation with the customer's name and address

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop hosting the catalogue spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The customer data in the user database is confidential because it contains names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses.
